data.desc: Similarweb (NYSE: SMWB) provides actionable insight about competition in the digital world, helping organizations understand and measure digital interactions everywhere they happen: web, apps, marketplaces, search, and AI. Founded in 2009, Similarweb turns billions of real-time digital signals into a single, complete view of the digital economy, not just a slice of it. Similarweb provides insight on what's happening online and what to do next to more than 10,000 organizations worldwide, including many of the leading technology players, largest brands, agencies, and investors.
